bar.module.name: Bar
bar.module.description: Drinks, snacks and merchandise: products and their sizes, price lists, the places that sell, and a panel in the till so drinks can go on the same payment as tickets. Needs Payments and Finance.
bar.abilities.product.manage.label: Set up the bar's categories, products and sizes
bar.abilities.price.manage.label: Set bar prices and price lists
bar.abilities.outlet.manage.label: Set up the places that sell from the bar
bar.abilities.stock.manage.label: Set up stock items, where they are kept and what each size uses up
bar.abilities.stock.view.label: See the bar's stock levels and movements
bar.abilities.stock.receive.label: Record deliveries and move stock between locations
bar.abilities.stock.waste.label: Write stock off as wasted
bar.abilities.stock.count.label: Count the bar's stock and submit the count
bar.abilities.stocktake.approve.label: Approve a stock count, which changes the levels
bar.settings.stocktake.blind.label: Count without seeing the expected level
bar.settings.stocktake.blind.help: Counters see only what they count, so the count is not led by the figure on the screen. The approver sees both.
bar.settings.stocktake.self-approve-unde: A counter may approve their own count when the difference is at most
Above this value, someone other than the person who submitted the count must approve it. The value is at each item's last pack cost.
bar.abilities.sale.sell.label: Sell from the bar in the till
bar.abilities.opening.manage.label: Close an outlet's trading
bar.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change the bar settings
bar.settings.sales.reference-prefix.help: One to three capital letters, so a bar sale's reference is not mistaken for a booking reference.
bar.abilities.age-check.view.label: Read the refusals register
bar.abilities.age-check.review.label: Sign the refusals register as checked
bar.settings.age-check.enabled.label: Ask for an age check
bar.settings.age-check.enabled.help: The till asks about the customer's age when a product that needs a check is sold, and keeps the refusals register. A premises licence usually requires both.
bar.settings.age-check.minimum-age.label: Legal age
bar.settings.age-check.minimum-age.help: The age at which a customer may buy products that need an age check. The till and the refusals register show it beside the age at which ID is asked for.
bar.settings.age-check.challenge-age.lab: Ask for ID if the customer looks under
bar.settings.age-check.challenge-age.hel: The age in the till's question, such as Challenge 25. It should be at least the legal age.
bar.settings.age-check.description.label: Keep a short description of a person refused
bar.settings.age-check.description.help: Adds an optional field of up to 120 characters to a refusal, for licence conditions that ask for one. It is shown only on the refusals register and is erased when the row passes the retention period.
bar.settings.age-check.review-every.labe: Sign the register at least every
bar.settings.age-check.review-every.help: How long the refusals register may go without a manager signing it as checked. After that, a reminder appears on the console home for whoever may sign it.
bar.settings.retention.age-checks.label: Keep the refusals register for
bar.settings.retention.age-checks.help: After this, descriptions of people refused are erased from the register.
bar.navigation.age-checks.label: Refusals register
bar.abilities.sale.view.label: See bar sales
bar.abilities.sale.refund.label: Ask for a refund of a bar sale
bar.abilities.allergens.manage.label: Record and check allergens
bar.settings.allergens.enabled.label: Show allergens
bar.settings.allergens.enabled.help: Shows an Allergens sheet on the till, from what has been recorded against each product's label.
bar.settings.allergens.recheck-every.hel: A stock item's label is due a fresh look this long after it was last checked, in case the recipe has changed. Deliveries ask about any that are due.
bar.settings.allergens.statement.label: Statement about shared equipment
bar.settings.allergens.statement.help: Always shown with allergens, for example: drinks are made behind one bar, so we cannot promise any is free from traces.
bar.settings.allergens.publish.label: Publish the allergen chart
bar.settings.allergens.publish.help: Shows the chart on the public site. Items not checked yet say so.
